desc: Derive/confirm the invariant: for right end r, valid subarrays ending at r = r − max{min(a,b) : pairs with max(a,b) ≤ r}; gain of removing pair p = Σ_{r where p is argmax} (M1(r) − M2(r)) with multiset second max.
Implement the full solution: normalize+bucket pairs by hi, sweep with (m1, owner, m2), accumulate total and gain, return total + max(gain, default=0).
Verify the two given examples by hand-trace (n=4 [[2,3],[1,4]] → base 6 + gain 3 = 9; n=5 [[1,2],[2,5],[3,5]] → base 9 + gain 3 = 12).
Verify edge/tie semantics: duplicate pairs and tied maxima yield M1 == M2 ⇒ zero gain (correct, partner still forbids); reversed input pairs normalized; m == 1 restores n(n+1)/2.
Confirm complexity O(n + m) time / O(n + m) space, comfortably within n = 1e5, m = 2e5 limits (no further perf work needed).
